evals.prompt: We just spent the session fixing a build that broke because skills moved from skills/custom/ to skills/. The validator assumed a category level, CI pointed at old paths, and the .agents mirror drifted. Write the lessons learnt.
evals.expected_output: One or more dated files under docs/lessons-learnt/ named YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM_<kind>_<topic>.md, plus an updated README.md index.
assertions: Each new file has a 'Written:' line and a 'Read when:' sentence
The failures file lists at least one rule phrased as an imperative with a re-check command
docs/lessons-learnt/README.md index has one new row per new file, newest first
No existing dated file was modified
The agent did not commit or push

evals.prompt: record what we learned today about the agentskills.io spec: version and author must go under metadata, compatibility is a string, and agentskills.io itself was unreachable from the sandbox so we read the spec from GitHub raw instead
evals.expected_output: A recon file whose facts each carry a source URL and a Checked date, and which states what could not be verified directly.
assertions: A file with kind 'recon' is written
The unreachable host is recorded under Open items or as not verified, not silently dropped
No secrets, tokens or private URLs appear in the file
